column9: Own Lithuanian patient testing explainer distinguishes blood testing from confirmation in many adults. No displayed edition date established; screening and diagnostic claims unappraised. Serology or genetic susceptibility is not automatically confirmed coeliac disease. Not a guideline or population study.

Own explainer distinguishes coeliac disease from allergy and sensitivity. Undated prevalence, family-risk and clinical statements not appraised; no Bulgarian population estimate or genotype diagnosis adopted. Own history states 2018 registration; AOECS current list links coeliac.bg, but continuity with older Bulgarian association not established. Footer 2026 is not a guideline edition.
